description: Make multiplayer a Play Kit platform capability: a versioned multiplayer.v1 contract in game-contracts, a transport-agnostic session system any cartridge opts into, a deployable tenant-bound session service, and Wizard vs Zombie as the first adopter in both race and shared-world tiers.
deviation_notes: Supersedes the app-local apps/advantage-games/measure/tracks/competitive_multiplayer_20260425, whose plan is unmodified template text and whose 4,424-line implementation is orphaned: nothing imports it and the app runs no custom server, so its WebSocket server is never started. S0 audit completed adopt/lift/discard. Corrected 2026-08-04: this note previously asserted Tutor Advantage runs a production race mode whose protocol wins ties — the S0 harvest disproved that (its race protocol is orphaned there too; ours is a one-field fork). Spec decision 3 was amended accordingly, and decision 6 was resolved by product-owner ruling: a room is the Lesson-plan class group, roster-gated, no outsiders.

sprint.goal: Any Play Kit cartridge can declare a multiplayer capability and get lobby, rounds, scoreboard, and results without writing transport code, and Wizard vs Zombie runs in both race and shared-world form on that capability.

stories.title: Audit the orphaned implementation and harvest the reference protocol
Freeze the multiplayer.v1 contract in game-contracts
Make the Wizard vs Zombie simulation deterministic
Add the multiplayer session capability to the Play Kit
Give the session service a deployable home
